Thanks again for the time today - great to learn more about FinLeaf's goals around embedding LLM features into your customer support flows and the latency/cost constraints you're tracking. Quick recap from my side:

- Primary use case: automated triage + suggested responses for Tier 1 support
- Key constraints: <200ms p95 for short responses, redaction/PII controls, audit logs for agents
- Next step: 30-minute product demo + brief technical deep-dive to walk through model behavior, routing options, and integration pattern

I pulled a few times that work on my calendar next week (all PT):
- Option A: Tue 2026-03-03 10:00-10:30 AM PT
- Option B: Wed 2026-03-04 11:00-11:30 AM PT
- Option C: Thu 2026-03-05 09:00-09:30 AM PT

Can you let me know which option works best and who from your team should join? I've CC'd Marissa (Solutions Engineer) - she'll lead the demo and cover the technical bits.

Attached is a short deck with a product overview and what we typically cover in a 30-min intro: redwood-demo-overview.pdf

If helpful, here's a quick calendar link to pick a time: https://calendar.redwood.ai/s/vanessa-30m

Thanks - looking forward to it.
